release.content: pubkit 0.10.0 was released on 2026-10-13 from commit eff2761196d736844e50dc91e99c924ea29dbfd0 with these changes.

rows: The kind python is renamed python-utility; sync fails, saying which name to use, on a pubkit.json naming the old one. The kind rust keeps its name

The kind service, for a private repository that deploys: a managed ./with-secrets runs one command with the secrets of a Bitwarden Secrets Manager project in its environment (read with bws and a read-only machine account's token; Terraform variables as TF_VAR_ or as a secret_values map, set in the seeded with-secrets.json), and the reusable workflow service-ci.yml checks sync, shellcheck, Terraform (fmt, validate) and the repository's tests

release.scope: the published release v0.10.0 of pubkit
